rows.blocker: Requires human participants and consented real-vault access.

source.heading: Distribution
source.clause: Signing and notarization require credentials; absent signing access yields unsigned preview artifacts and a separate external handoff.

rows.acceptance_criteria: The handoff names platform credentials, owner and exact signed-artifact verification steps without treating unsigned preview as release-ready.
rows.blocker: Signing certificates/notarization credentials are not available to this goal.

source.heading: P6: Release
source.clause: Publication, hosted staging and public release execution follow implementation and require the assigned project setup and release authority.

rows.acceptance_criteria: The handoff identifies project/environment prerequisites and verifies publication only after an authorized release tag and signed artifacts.
rows.blocker: Public release authority and hosted target are outside this implementation goal.
